description: Cycle Routes of Biscay is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.bizkaia.eus. Geographic information on the location and status of cycle routes in Biscay. It includes all the cycle lanes built, planned or under construction in the Historical Territory of Biscay, as well as various attributes relating to the cycle lanes, such as type of lane, ownership of the platform, the area along which it runs,... Coverage: ES. Its keywords include Bizikleta Ibilbideak, Vía Ciclista, Cycling, Cycleway, Bizikleta Bidea, Rutas Ciclables. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, ATOM, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
